description: This file is a Spring Security configuration class that sets up security filters, CORS policies, and authentication management for a Java web application, specifically configuring JWT-based stateless security with certain endpoints permitted without authentication.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Main configuration class for setting up security filters, CORS, and authentication management in a Spring Boot application.

methods.name: passwordEncoder
methods.description: Defines a bean for password encoding using BCryptPasswordEncoder.

methods.name: authenticationManager
methods.description: Provides the AuthenticationManager bean configured via AuthenticationConfiguration.

methods.name: filterChain
methods.description: Configures the security filter chain, including CSRF disabling, CORS configuration, session management, request authorization, and JWT filter integration.

methods.name: corsConfigurationSource
methods.description: Creates and configures CORS settings, including allowed origins, methods, headers, and exposed headers.
